Thanks Alice — good window. Quick notes from hiring side:

- Preferred sequencing (to minimize context switches):
  1) System design (Marissa) — 45m deep-dive (covers distributed sys design + tradeoffs)
  2) Backend platform (Jonas) — 30m (live snippet / architecture questions)
  3) API/SDK & interoperability (Laura) — 30m
  4) Coding pair (internal interviewer TBD) — 45m (we'll use a shared editor)
  5) Hiring manager wrap (30m)

- Request: make the coding session after at least one design conversation so the candidate can draw on the design discussion.
- Quiet-window: yes — reserve a 25-30m quiet break after the second slot (midpoint) so candidate has time to rest.
- Buffer: add a 15m buffer between the 45m sessions and 30m ones to allow tech issues and quick sync.

I attached a draft 'panel-jigsaw-agenda-v1.pdf' with timestamps mapped to the candidate availability block (I moved start to 09:30 PT to accommodate interviewers' schedules).

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm you’re fine with the longer system design and coding placement? If so I’ll ask People Ops to book the interviewer pool and set up the shared editor link.

Cheers,
